title: Proposal
description: Body of POST /api/v1/agent/proposals, the Planner's only consequential tool (propose_payment). account_id must equal the vendor's verified registry account (else hard rule PAYEE_NOT_IN_REGISTRY); it is never taken from invoice text. invoice_fingerprint is computed server-side.

account_id.description: Vendor registry bank-account id (from the lookup_vendor tool).

requested_execution_date.description: Earlier than due_date only when the scheduler found a discount with APR above the hurdle.

rationale.description: Planner's explanation; LLM output, so untrusted and display-only.
